newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil firm, tight.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil firm, tight.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil was firmer on Monday and product in the region was tight, traders said.
High sulphur barges changed hands between $102.50 and $105 fob ARA, with prices heard at $105 in late trading.

Cargo numbers were firm, supported by demand for cargoes to fill the latest Portuguese tender. Offer levels were heard at around $107 cif NWE but little product was seen available. More is seen available in the Mediterranean.
In addition to Portugal-related demand, at least one utility is thought to be short of product in September.

News that Russian Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasim was opposed to winter fuel oil export limits, contradicting threats of curbs from the fuel and energy ministry last week, failed to rein in rising prices.
Low sulphur fuel oil was strong, too. One refiner was heard offering 40,000 tonnes of late September product out of western France at $110 fob NWE, but no business was heard done.
September swaps were heard traded at $109-$109.50 fob NWE.
